source_snapshot.procedure: Power on, enter the BMC Advanced License if needed, open Power & Thermal > Power Settings, record Maximum Available/Peak Observed/Minimum Observed watts, enable capping, set the cap to Maximum Available Power, apply, then run the OS stress tool for 30 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: CPU capping is enabled; on Power Meter the Average Power line stays below the Power Cap line, while Maximum Power may cross above it.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL suggests WebUI or a guessed Redfish PATCH plus grep-based power reads, but does not preserve secure license entry, discovered control scope, exact WebUI evidence, 30-hour duration, watchdogs or original-state restoration.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because cap scope/value, license protection, stress/watchdog and restore rules were not yet made executable; it correctly rejects write/stress execution without those controls.

old_problem: Historical review treated Maximum Available as potentially non-constraining, CPU-versus-chassis scope and 30-hour-versus-1440-minute fields as unresolved core conflicts. ED-03/04/07/08 establish that platform mapping and runtime controls are Project inputs and Machine Time is normally planning metadata. The source itself defines the Master value and acceptance: configure the maximum boundary, prove enable/readback, run the full 30 hours, and evaluate Average versus Cap while allowing Maximum excursions. It does not promise that active throttling must occur.
disposition_reason: Treat this exact Master as a maximum-boundary cap configuration and endurance case, not a lower-cap throttling demonstration. The engineer must prove that the OEM WebUI control is the Project-approved CPU/power domain, capture original enable/value, securely handle any licensed feature, apply the displayed Maximum Available value once, verify readback, run the unshortened 30-hour approved stress under watchdogs, preserve actual Power Meter visuals/time series, and restore the original state. A lower cap may be an explicit Project override but must report its coverage delta separately.
decision_basis: XLSX row 989, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 990 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 990 / variant ab1c225357588fd2.

ED-07 and ED-08 make the 1440-minute Machine Time a planning value unless independently normative; the explicit 30-hour Procedure remains the Master duration and cannot be shortened to 24 hours or a smoke run.

DMTF defines PowerLimit.LimitInWatts as the limit in watts and null as disabled, while newer Control resources expose setpoint/control state. The actual resource must be discovered and its CPU/chassis domain proven; no `/Chassis/1/Power` URI or write payload is guessed.

Maximum Available Power is a source-defined dynamic boundary value. Applying and reading it back tests maximum-boundary configuration and long-run adherence; it does not guarantee observable throttling. Any separate lower-cap throttling objective is an approved override with explicit coverage delta, never a silent replacement.

ED-05, ED-08, ED-12, ED-15 through ED-20, ED-24 through ED-27 and ED-30/31 preserve duration, visual UI, tool coverage, source identity, operator control, recovery and no retry; ED-33 through ED-38 permit parameterized execution with protected tools and engineer verdict.

test_case.test_name: Set the approved maximum-available CPU power cap, run 30-hour stress, verify Power Meter behavior and restore
test_case.purpose: Verify on the exact licensed platform that the OEM CPU/power-domain cap can be enabled and set to the WebUI's displayed Maximum Available Power, remains correctly applied during the full 30-hour approved OS stress, keeps the displayed Average Power below the Power Cap while allowing Maximum Power excursions, and is safely restored afterward.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/firmware/WebUI/license identity and vendor/Project proof that the named Power Settings control applies to the intended CPU or approved power domain rather than an unrelated chassis/PSU control
Secure authorized Advanced License workflow; entitlement/key is entered only by an engineer through the approved UI and is never recorded in commands, screenshots or logs
Actual rendered WebUI access to Maximum Available, Peak Observed, Minimum Observed, cap enable/value/apply/readback and Power Meter Average/Maximum/Cap lines
Captured original cap enabled/value/mode and owner-approved final state, with a tested restore path and post-restore readback
Approved 30-hour stress tool/version/profile and environment, maintenance window, workload isolation, thermal/power/performance/OS/BMC watchdog thresholds, sampling cadence and stop/incident rules
Discovered read-only API/telemetry mapping if used for assistance, synchronized clocks, secret-safe access, comparison tolerance and evidence storage
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Verify exact SUT/BMC and qualified CPU/power-control domain, preserve logs and capture original cap enable/value plus health. A qualified engineer confirms or securely enters the authorized Advanced License without exposing the key, then operates the actual WebUI: record Maximum Available, Peak Observed and Minimum Observed watts; enable capping if needed; set exactly the displayed Maximum Available value; Apply; capture rendered pre/post images and readback. After a separate unchanged-run approval, start the pinned Project stress workload for the full 30 consecutive hours and collect synchronized Power Meter Average/Maximum/Cap, OS workload/performance, thermal, power, BMC, service and alarm time series under approved watchdogs. Average must remain below Cap according to the approved window/tolerance; Maximum may cross as the source permits. Stop on a safety threshold without retry. Finally, under restoration authorization restore the original enable/value/mode, verify readback and health. A lower cap is allowed only as a separately recorded Project override with Master-coverage delta; never claim it is the exact Master run.
test_case.expected_result: The intended cap domain and licensed control are proven, all three source watt values are recorded, Maximum Available is accepted and read back with capping enabled, and the full 30-hour approved stress completes without safety, OS/BMC, service or data-integrity failure. Over the approved Power Meter evaluation windows, Average Power remains below the Cap line; Maximum excursions are recorded but do not fail this source criterion. The original cap state is restored and verified. No claim of active throttling is made unless independent qualified evidence shows it.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS for the exact Master requires qualified CPU/power-domain mapping, actual WebUI/license evidence, original-state capture, Maximum Available write/readback, complete 30-hour stress, all Average-versus-Cap windows passing the approved sampling/tolerance rule, allowed Maximum excursions correctly reported, no watchdog/health failure and verified restoration. A read-only query, guessed API, 24-hour/short run, lower-cap override without coverage delta, absence of rendered WebUI evidence, average below an unverified line, or failure to restore cannot pass. If mapping, thresholds, stress package or restore plan is missing, report NOT READY rather than keeping the engineering decision Pending.
safety_gate: Require an authorized engineer for Advanced License and WebUI operations; never expose or retain license/password secrets and never guess an API write.
Require explicit approval for the cap mutation and unchanged 30-hour stress run after verifying exact target, workload isolation, original cap state and restore path.
Preserve logs and baseline health; do not clear SEL/OS evidence. Record every cap write/readback and stress start/stop.
Use Project-approved thermal, input power, CPU/package, performance, OS/service, BMC reachability and facility watchdog thresholds. No threshold means NOT READY, not PASS.
Stop once on any approved safety threshold, control mismatch, lost monitoring, workload failure or unexpected alarm; do not automatically restart stress or reapply the cap.
Restoration is mandatory even after test failure when safe. A failed restore is an incident requiring escalation, not another automatic write.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/WebUI/license and CPU/power-domain qualification, approvals, secure-license audit and original cap state
Actual rendered WebUI captures of the three watt values, enable/value before and after Apply, and confirmed Maximum Available readback
Pinned 30-hour stress tool/profile, start/end/continuity record and synchronized Power Meter Average/Maximum/Cap time series
Thermal/power/performance/OS/BMC/service watchdog and expected/unexpected log evidence, including any allowed Maximum excursions
Original cap enable/value restoration/readback, final health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict; any override and coverage delta reported separately
test_case.recovery: On a safety, workload, monitoring or cap anomaly, stop the stress once, preserve all logs and keep the system in the owner-defined safe workload state. When safe and explicitly authorized, restore the captured original cap enable/value/mode through the qualified UI/control, verify readback and OS/BMC/thermal/service health, and escalate any failed restoration or license/control inconsistency. Do not repeat the 30-hour run automatically.

source_conflict.reason: ED-07/08 resolves 1440 minutes as planning metadata while preserving the explicit 30-hour Procedure. The title/domain is bound by a required vendor Project map, and Maximum Available is treated as the exact boundary configuration—not falsely as guaranteed active throttling. Lower-cap coverage remains a separate override.

blocked.reason: The Master method, value, duration and acceptance are executable as a maximum-boundary endurance case. Exact control-domain mapping, license entitlement, stress/watchdog thresholds and restoration are finite Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Qualified CPU/power-control domain; licensed firmware/UI; secure entitlement handling; original/final cap state; 30-hour stress profile; watchdog thresholds; sampling/tolerance; discovered telemetry and restoration runbook.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; NO LICENSE ENTRY, WEBUI, CAP WRITE, STRESS, LOG, API OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

project_authority: The Project/vendor owner proves the cap's CPU/power domain, supplies secure licensing, exact stress profile, safety/performance thresholds, sampling/tolerance and restore path. The Master remains Maximum Available for 30 hours; any lower-value project test is explicitly an override with coverage delta.
